services.name: PostgreSQL (Neon)
services.function: Primary relational database for all application data (users, projects, quotes, payments, etc.)
services.notes: Pool connection for app (DATABASE_URL), direct connection for migrations (DIRECT_URL). ORM: Prisma v5.18.0

services.name: Redis
services.function: Session storage, caching (user profiles, search results), queue backend for Bull job processing
routes: All routes that use caching middleware
services.notes: Supports rediss:// (TLS) and redis:// schemes. In-memory fallback in non-prod. CircuitBreaker + failover. Production requires REDIS_URL or startup fails.

services.name: Bull Queues (Job Processing)
services.function: Asynchronous job processing for emails, PDFs, analytics, payments, badges. Backed by Redis.
services.notes: 5 queues: emails (5 concurrency), pdfs (2), analytics (1), payments (3), badges (2). Retries: 3x with exponential backoff.

services.name: Mailjet
services.function: Email delivery for verification codes, password resets, package suspension notifications, generic notification fallback
services.notes: API v3.1. CircuitBreaker + RateLimiter. 5s timeout. Optional (dev mode: logs codes to console).

services.name: Twilio
services.function: SMS sending for phone verification codes and alerts
services.notes: CircuitBreaker + RateLimiter. 5s timeout. Optional (dev mode: logs codes to console).

services.name: PostgreSQL Full-Text Search
services.function: Full-text search pour professionals, projects, portfolio, packages, reviews via PostgreSQL ILIKE/full-text queries.
services.notes: MeiliSearch retiré en v0.0.2 (commit 3b386a9). La recherche utilise PostgreSQL directement. 6/6 endpoints 200 OK en production.

services.name: Cloudinary
services.function: Image and media upload/storage. Profile avatars, portfolio project images, verification photos.
services.notes: Supports auto resource type detection. Folders: manawa/avatars, manawa/verification, manawa/portfolio. Optional (dev mode: fails gracefully).

services.name: Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM)
services.function: Push notifications to Android/iOS via Firebase. Fallback to Expo for backward compatibility.
services.notes: Env var (prod) or local JSON file (dev). Supports FCM, APNs, Expo token types. Email fallback if no tokens.

services.name: Expo Push Service
services.function: Backward compatibility push notifications for Expo clients before full FCM migration
services.notes: URL: https://exp.host/--/api/v2/push/send. 5s timeout. Auto-detected by token format (ExponentPushToken[...]).

services.name: Socket.io
services.function: WebSocket real-time communication for live chat, notifications, presence updates
routes: WebSocket namespace handlers in socket/ directory
services.notes: v4.7.5. Inherits CORS from app. Used for messages, notifications, live updates.

services.name: GeniusPay
services.function: Payment processing, transaction handling, subscription billing. Alternative: CinetPay.
services.notes: CircuitBreaker (5 failures/5min) + AdaptiveRateLimiter. 15s timeout. Webhook signature verification required.

services.name: Daily.co
services.function: Video call room creation/management for professional consultations
services.notes: API: https://api.daily.co/v1. Graceful degradation if no API key. Optional.

services.name: Sentry
services.function: Error tracking, performance monitoring, breadcrumb logging for debugging
services.notes: 20% trace sample rate. Breadcrumbs for auth, payment, search, database, API. Optional (non-blocking init).

services.name: Node.js Cron Jobs
services.function: Scheduled background jobs: secret rotation, backup sync, admin log cleanup, webhook retry scheduling, analytics calculations
services.notes: Library: node-cron v3.0.3. Runs in-process after server startup.

services.name: JWT (Authentication)
services.function: User authentication tokens, session management, token refresh
services.notes: Library: jsonwebtoken v9.0.2. Min 32 chars. Sign/verify in middleware/auth.js.

services.name: Prisma ORM
services.function: SQL query builder and schema management for PostgreSQL. Migrations, type safety.
services.notes: v5.18.0. Client auto-generated. Migrations in prisma/migrations/.

services.name: Express.js
services.function: HTTP server framework, routing, middleware orchestration
services.notes: v4.19.2. Compression (gzip + Brotli), Helmet security, CORS, rate limiting configured.
